import json, os
from pathlib import Path
import swdb
from swdb import artifacts, bfs_protocol
root=Path(os.environ['LANL_SWDB']).resolve()
assert Path(swdb.__file__).resolve().parent==root/'swdb'
assert Path(artifacts.__file__).resolve().parent==root/'swdb'
assert Path(bfs_protocol.__file__).resolve().parent==root/'swdb'
print(json.dumps({'package_root':str(Path(swdb.__file__).resolve().parent),
                 'pythonpath':os.environ['PYTHONPATH'], 'imports':['swdb','artifacts','bfs_protocol']}))
